process.label: How we work with you

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: We see how your team works today, where time gets lost and where errors creep in. Only then do we propose.

design.title: Design
design.text: You review and adjust the screens with us before a single line of code is written.

build.title: Build
build.text: We deliver in parts: you try the system while it's being built, not just at the end.

maintain.title: Maintain
maintain.text: After launch we're still here, adjusting and adding whatever your operation needs next.

process.note: One team through all four stages. Nothing gets lost between vendors.

services.title: What we do for your business
services.subtitle: Services you can hire separately or combine, depending on where your company is today.

web.title: Web and mobile development
web.description: Web systems and mobile apps built around the way you work, not around a generic template.

consulting.title: Consulting
consulting.description: Before you invest, we help you decide what to build, what to buy and what to leave as it is.

transformation.title: Digital transformation
transformation.description: We make the processes that depend on paper or manual steps digital, and automate the repetitive tasks.

optimization.title: Optimization
optimization.description: Got a slow system, or one nobody wants to use? We review it and improve it without throwing out what works.

cloud.title: Cloud migration
cloud.description: We move your systems to the cloud: you log in from anywhere and stop depending on a server in the office.

products.title: Our own products
products.subtitle: Besides custom projects, we turn what we learn into tools for problems many companies share.

intro.title: Your company’s complement
intro.lead: In our logo, the green piece is the one that completes the shape. That is how we see our work: being the technology piece your company is missing, so your team can focus on what it does best.

people.label: Who you talk to
people.value: The people who design and code your system

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: Create innovative and quality technological solutions that improve client processes and foster their growth.

vision.label: Vision
vision.text: To be leaders in digital transformation and software development, standing out for excellence and scalable solutions.

values.title: Our values
values.subtitle: What they mean when we work with you.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: We use new technology when it solves your problem better than the familiar option, not because it is fashionable.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.text: We tell you what is right for you, even if it means building less.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.text: When we agree on a date or a scope, we keep it; if something changes, you hear it from us first.

client.title: Client focus
client.text: We design around how your team works, not around what is convenient for us to code.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.text: Design, development and support work together from day one, with you at the table.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: We test every delivery before you use it, and keep looking after it afterwards.

team.title: The team
team.subtitle: The people who lead and build your project.

christian.bio: Runs the company and works with every client from the first conversation: understands the problem, sets the scope and makes sure what we deliver solves what was agreed.

jose.bio: Leads development: shapes the architecture of each system, reviews the team’s code and answers for it running well in production.

faustina.bio: Leads Bacsystem’s marketing and communication: how we present our services and products, and how they reach the companies that need them.

intro.title: Find what you need
intro.lead: Each service, with the situations where it helps and what you get. If you are not sure where to start, consulting is a good first step.

web.title: Web and mobile development
web.summary: From the internal system that organizes your operation to the app for your field staff or the portal where your customers look things up on their own.

fit.spreadsheets: Your operation runs on spreadsheets that get copied and overwritten, and nobody knows which version is the right one.
fit.workaround: You tried an off-the-shelf product and ended up adapting your way of working to it, instead of the other way around.
fit.requests: Your customers ask by email or WhatsApp for information they could look up themselves.

deliverables.system: The working system: web, mobile or both, as agreed.
deliverables.integrations: Connections to the systems you already use, where they're needed.
deliverables.training: Training and user guides for the people who will use it.
deliverables.support: Support after launch to adjust whatever your operation needs next.

consulting.title: Technology consulting
consulting.summary: We review your processes and the systems you use today, and give you a clear recommendation with its reasons, even if that recommendation is to build nothing.

fit.quotes: You have very different quotes for the same project and don't know how to compare them.
fit.buyOrBuild: You have to choose between an off-the-shelf product and custom software, and you don't want to get it wrong.
fit.noTeam: Your company has grown, but you don't have an IT team to help you decide.

deliverables.diagnosis: An assessment of your processes and the systems you use today.
deliverables.recommendation: A written recommendation: what to build, what to buy and what to keep.
deliverables.plan: A plan in stages, with priorities, so you can move forward within your budget.
deliverables.review: A review of other vendors' proposals, if you already have some on the table.

transformation.title: Digital transformation
transformation.summary: We start with the process that takes up most of your team's time, not all of them at once. We bring it into one place, connect its steps and let the system handle the repetitive work.

fit.paper: Approvals, orders or reports still go through paper or long email chains.
fit.retyping: Your team types the same data into two or three different systems.
fit.reports: To know how the business is doing, someone has to put a report together by hand.

deliverables.map: A map of how the process works today and how it will work.
deliverables.digital: The process in digital form: forms, approvals and records in one place.
deliverables.automation: Automations for the repetitive tasks, such as notifications, calculations or reports.
deliverables.adoption: Support for your team while it gets used to the new way of working.

optimization.title: Systems optimization
optimization.summary: First we find where the problem is; then we fix it, starting with what affects your team the most day to day.

fit.slow: Your system is slow to respond and the team loses time waiting.
fit.avoided: People avoid the system and go back to Excel because it's hard to use.
fit.untouchable: Nobody dares to touch the system because whoever built it has left.

deliverables.review: A technical review listing the problems found, ordered by impact.
deliverables.fixes: Bug and performance fixes, applied to your system.
deliverables.screens: Improvements to the screens your team uses the most.
deliverables.docs: Documentation of what we changed, so the system no longer depends on a single person.

cloud.title: Cloud migration
cloud.summary: We make the move in stages, so your team's daily work is affected as little as possible while your systems and data move over.

fit.server: Your systems live on a server in the office and, if it fails, everything stops.
fit.remote: Your team needs to work from home, from another branch or out in the field.
fit.backups: You're not sure when your data was last backed up.

deliverables.plan: A migration plan: what moves, in what order and how to roll back if something fails.
deliverables.migration: Your systems and data running in the cloud.
deliverables.costs: Recommendations to keep your monthly cloud bill under control.

intro.title: khipu
intro.tagline: Electronic invoicing for SUNAT, from a web portal or connected to your system.
intro.lead: You record the sale; khipu calculates the totals, builds the XML in SUNAT's format, signs it with your digital certificate and sends it. You get the acceptance receipt and the PDF for your customer.
intro.status: Free plan forever, no card needed

preview.label: Example of an invoice issued with khipu, with the steps of sending it to SUNAT

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Setup happens once. After that, issuing is a single step.

certificate.title: Upload your digital certificate and SOL credentials
certificate.text: They are stored encrypted and khipu uses them to sign every document. You don't touch them again.

series.title: Set up your series
series.text: F001, B001…, each with its own sequence and, if you have several locations, its branch.

issue.title: Issue from the portal or from your system
issue.text: khipu calculates the totals, builds the XML, signs it and sends it to SUNAT.

receipt.title: Get the receipt
receipt.text: The signed XML, the PDF and SUNAT's receipt are stored, and you can email them to your customer.

benefits.title: What stops being your problem
benefits.subtitle: Calculating, signing and resending are khipu's job.

totals.title: Totals checked before signing
totals.text: Amounts are calculated and validated on the server, which avoids rejections for mismatched totals.

retries.title: If SUNAT doesn't respond, khipu retries
retries.text: The document stays pending and is resent on its own, never lost and never numbered twice.

checks.title: Errors caught before numbering
checks.text: If a field SUNAT would reject is missing, such as a mistyped RUC, you are warned before a number from your series is used.

storage.title: Your documents, always at hand
storage.text: Download the XML, the PDF and the receipt of any document whenever you need them.

pdf.title: The PDF with your brand
pdf.text: Choose the template, the color, your logo and the texts of the printed version.

portal.title: Companies and shops
portal.text: Issue from the portal, filter by series, status or date, and review each document's history, without writing code.

api.title: Teams with their own system
api.text: If you already have a sales system or an ERP, connect it to khipu through a REST API, with documentation and a test environment.

accountants.title: Accountants and firms
accountants.text: Manage several companies (RUC) from a single account and download their documents whenever you need them.

documents.title: What you can issue
documents.subtitle: Marked exactly as it is today. Credit and debit notes are issued on invoices; notes on receipts are on the way too.

contact.title: Issue your first invoice today
contact.subtitle: Create your account, set up your company and check in SUNAT's test environment that your documents are accepted, without paying anything.

intro.title: Our products
intro.lead: Software we build and maintain ourselves. We tell you plainly which one you can use today and which one we are still building.

khipu.summary: Electronic invoicing without building XML or chasing resends: khipu calculates, signs and sends every document. You start on the free plan.

intro.title: Wanka
intro.tagline: The management system for your business, adapted to your industry.
intro.lead: One system to sell, track your stock and issue your documents. The dashboard and the menu change with your type of business, so you don't see screens you don't use.

industries.title: Built for each industry
industries.subtitle: Besides what they all share, each type of business has its own screens.

restaurant.title: Restaurants
restaurant.text: Floor plan with tables, kitchen display, delivery and reservations.

veterinary.title: Veterinary clinics
veterinary.text: A record for each pet, hospitalization and grooming.

dental.title: Dental practices
dental.text: Appointment calendar and clinical record with an odontogram.

retail.title: Shops
retail.text: Products with variants, such as size and color, and quick checkout.

sales.title: Point of sale and cash
sales.text: Quick sales, quotes and cash closing with its daily report.

invoicing.title: Electronic invoicing
invoicing.text: Receipts, invoices, credit notes and dispatch guides for SUNAT.

inventory.title: Inventory by warehouse
inventory.text: Stock in each warehouse or branch, movements, transfers, physical counts and kardex.

customers.title: Customers
customers.text: Each customer's record, with their purchases and appointments.

purchases.title: Purchases and accounts
purchases.text: Suppliers, purchase orders, receivables and payables.

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: Sales and management reports, and the records SUNAT requires.
